---
name: vibeschool-dependency-integrity
description: Repair earlier canonical dependencies when later VibeSchool work exposes defects and invalidate stale downstream evidence.
---
# Dependency Integrity
When later work exposes an earlier dependency defect, verify it, map affected descendants, invalidate stale READY/CERTIFIED evidence, repair the earliest canonical root cause, rerun affected proofs and only then resume the interrupted mission. Do not patch every descendant independently or preserve a known-bad foundation because downstream work is already advanced.
